question: Is the website SEO-friendly?
answer: Yes. Every website has a clean URL structure, meta titles and descriptions, schema markup, a sitemap, and fast loading, so it is easy to read for Google and AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Gemini. The Small Business package is registered with Google so people can find it when they search your business name. Starter, Business, and Prime also include blog articles for SEO (2, 5, and 10 articles), and Prime uses full SEO.
